tabs.overview: A double-walled or bunded cube tank of a few hundred to a few thousand gallons with a transfer pump, meter and hose reel. The frac pumps themselves take fuel from the fuel row trailers; the cube feeds the small engines.
tabs.engineering: Sized for the small-engine fleet between deliveries; grounding point and a fire extinguisher at the dispensing side.
tabs.safety: No smoking or hot work within the fuel area; engines off while fueling; spill kit at the pump; grounding before transfer.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Fuel cube
function: A bunded diesel tank with its own pump and hose for the light towers, generators and forklift.
